sql: select e.key, ep.epoch_number, ep.started_at, ep.impact_class, (select count(distinct lo.market_ticker) from live_orders lo join experiment_deployment_arms a on a.id=lo.experiment_deployment_arm_id join experiment_deployments d on d.id=a.deployment_id join experiment_epochs ep2 on ep2.id=d.epoch_id where ep2.id=ep.id) as live_mkts, (select count(distinct lo.market_ticker) from live_orders lo join experiment_deployment_arms a on a.id=lo.experiment_deployment_arm_id join experiment_deployments d on d.id=a.deployment_id join experiment_epochs ep2 on ep2.id=d.epoch_id join kalshi_market_ownership o on o.ticker=lo.market_ticker and o.owner='main' where ep2.id=ep.id) as claimed_main from experiments e join experiment_versions v on v.experiment_id=e.id join experiment_epochs ep on ep.version_id=v.id where ep.ended_at is null and e.key in ('mmsell-win-set','mmsell-price-ceiling-cell-size','mmsell-price-ceiling-size-split','mmsell-price-ceiling','mmsell-price-ceiling-capacity','mmsell-price-ceiling-contest-cap','liquidity-incentive-mm','mmsell-rain-season','mmsell-temperature-season','mmsell-weather-bands') order by ep.started_at
